title: EmDash publication retires the Change store with a protected archive
context: Blueprint Change pages lived on a dedicated Git branch. Moving publication to EmDash removes Git deployment from content updates, while the old store remains evidence that must be preserved and recoverable during migration.
decision: Store each Blueprint Change as one EmDash entry at its stable slug. Retire the remote blueprint-changes store only after the fixed snapshot has been completely converted, all 45 pages have passed isolated import, read-back and per-page semantic and visual review, and archive plus rollback evidence is accepted before G2. Preserve every commit reachable from the fixed snapshot in a protected archive tag; earlier unreachable commits are not guaranteed. Formal production import reuses the same verified artifact without reconversion, with environment-specific media references rebound and verified. Keep one-time conversion and import tools until production import, read-back, formal cutover and rollback evidence are accepted, then remove them. Production activation is a separate post-G2 approval.

alternatives.option: Retire the store before the EmDash migration is proven
alternatives.reason: Would discard the only complete source before content fidelity and recovery have been established.
Creates a second transformation with a different result from the artifact reviewed before G2.
Leaves migration-only code and inputs as permanent maintenance surface after production acceptance.

consequences: EmDash publication changes a page without a Git commit, build or deployment.
The fixed snapshot remains recoverable through its protected reachable commit graph and retained final receipts.
The production import is reproducible from the exact artifact reviewed before G2; media references can be rebound for the target environment.
Production activation and remote store retirement remain explicitly authorized steps.
revisitTriggers: The fixed snapshot cannot be fully represented by Portable Text and typed blocks without losing meaning.
The archive tag or rollback evidence cannot recover the verified migration source.
